# Soft386 R3 handoff

R3 adds process vessels without changing any existing native DLL implementation
or export ABI.

## New behavior

* DOSCALLS.283 and .280 join the bounded native bridge.
* DosExecPgm deep-copies object buffer, argv block, environment block,
  RESULTCODES and program path across the guest/native boundary.
* The host process backend is forced to launch the current `soft386_os2.exe` as
  the OS/2 loader, creating a fresh Tiny386 jar for every child.
* `--run-quiet`/`--argv0` compatibility accepts the command line generated by
  the existing DOSCALLS process backend.
* Personality DLL paths are propagated to descendants through inherited,
  absolute `SOFT386_*_DLL` environment settings.
* Normal scheduler switch messages are silent unless scheduler/hostcall tracing
  is explicitly enabled.
* Producer/consumer LE fixtures are included for pipeline acceptance.

## Proven locally

Linux/GCC and Linux/Clang both pass the inherited R2C suite plus:

* DosExecPgm/DosWaitChild fake-provider pointer marshalling;
* child-vessel loader-switch acceptance;
* `--run-quiet` diagnostic suppression.

Actual CreateProcess/DOSCALLS process execution and pipelines require the
32-bit Windows/RosBE live test.
